description: Cycling covers riding safely and legally, fitting and maintaining a bike, handling skills, and a series of road or trail rides of increasing distance, planned with the buddy system.

safety.note: Always wear a properly fitted helmet, follow traffic laws and ride with a buddy. Electric bikes are not used for this badge.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 6 offers a road-biking or a trail-biking option; their sub-items are summarized. Electric bikes are not permitted for this badge.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
Major Requirement Changes as of January 1, 2026 (scouting.org)

requirements.title: Hazards and first aid
requirements.summary: Cycling hazards and how to prevent them, first aid for cycling injuries, and poisonous plants and animals where you ride.

requirements.title: Laws and riding on roads
requirements.summary: Bicycle laws, how they compare with motor-vehicle laws, and where and how to ride on roads.

requirements.title: Clothing and gear
requirements.summary: Clothing and gear including a properly fitted helmet, and Scouting America’s bike safety guidelines.

requirements.title: Bike maintenance
requirements.summary: Cleaning, adjusting and inspecting a bike with a safety checklist.

requirements.title: Handling skills
requirements.summary: Mounting, starting, stopping, turning, shifting, scanning and signaling.

requirements.title: Riding program
requirements.summary: One option: road biking with a safety test and rides of increasing distance, or trail biking with skills, a trail safety test and trail rides.
